decide.intent: synthesize independent Coder and Reviewer proposals into an approved spec-design commit

code.intent: implement a coding intent in reviewed, one-commit phases, using an intent record when needed

review.intent: review a supplied scope of committed work until no unsettled findings remain

nodes.description: Waiting for a caller to start a review.
Reviewer runs the first review round over the review scope.
Coder accepts or rejects each of Reviewer's findings and commits any accepted fixes.
Reviewer runs the next review round over the cumulative committed state after a review-fix commit.
Reviewer runs the next review round after Coder rejected every finding without a commit.
Waiting for Boss to answer the acting agent's question.
REVIEW parked after a failure and waits for Boss to restart or resume it.
REVIEW completed: the review scope was evaluated at the returned revision and no unsettled findings remain.
